claims.text: A Deployment keeps old ReplicaSets (scaled to 0) as its rollout history; each Pod template change creates a numbered revision; kubectl rollout history lists the revision numbers.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (Checking Rollout History of a Deployment; revision is created when template changes)

claims.text: .spec.revisionHistoryLimit (a Deployment field; not set in Đơn Hàng's manifests) sets how many old ReplicaSets are retained; it defaults to 10.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (Revision History Limit: by default, 10 old ReplicaSets will be kept)

claims.text: A container whose image cannot be pulled shows ErrImagePull right after a failed pull, then ImagePullBackOff while the kubelet waits, with an increasing back-off delay, to retry.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Images (ImagePullBackOff: back-off delay increases, up to a cap)

claims.text: With replicas 2 and default maxSurge/maxUnavailable, a rollout whose new Pod never becomes available removes no old Pod: both old Pods keep running.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (Rolling Update; Failed Deployment); outputs/stage-2/scripts/k8s/rollback.txt

claims.text: Kubernetes does not roll back a stuck Deployment; after progressDeadlineSeconds (a Deployment setting) it sets Progressing=False (ProgressDeadlineExceeded), shown under Conditions by kubectl describe deployment.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (Failed Deployment: 'Kubernetes takes no action on a stalled Deployment other than to report a status condition')

claims.text: rollout undo makes the previous revision's template current; its old ReplicaSet becomes current and is scaled to the desired count (back up if it was at 0), the bad one down to 0. Stuck update: only the scale-down, no new Pod.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (Rolling Back to a Previous Revision); kubectl rollout undo reference

claims.text: After an undo, the restored revision is renumbered as the newest revision and disappears from its old number (history 1, 2, 3 becomes 1, 3, 4).
claims.source_hint: outputs/stage-2/scripts/k8s/rollback.txt; kubernetes.io Deployments (rollback creates a new revision)

claims.text: kubectl rollout undo changes only the object in the cluster; the manifest file is unchanged, so applying it again re-applies its template (the bad tag). No image is built: the old template names an image already in the registry.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Declarative management with kubectl apply; rollback.sh@stage-2 comment lines 40-41

claims.text: kubectl rollout status --timeout=10s prints 'Waiting for deployment "api" rollout to finish: 1 out of 2 new replicas have been updated...' then 'error: timed out waiting for the condition'.
deploy/k8s/lessons/api-deployment-bad-tag.yaml@stage-2 uses ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api:sha- plus 40 zeros, a tag never pushed; otherwise like api-deployment-1.0.0.yaml.

rollback.sh@stage-2 rebuilds revisions sha-bb18 then 1.0.0, shows history, applies the bad tag, waits for ImagePullBackOff (0.5 s x 360), rollout status 10 s, undo, history, get -o wide, then applies 1.0.0 again.
Applying a manifest whose Pod template equals the current one adds no revision; after rollback.sh, ReplicaSets are 1.0.0 at 2, sha-bb18 and sha-0000 at 0, history 1, 3, 4.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (rollout triggered only by template change)

claims.text: CHANGE-CAUSE shows the kubernetes.io/change-cause annotation of each revision (why it was made); Đơn Hàng sets none, so it shows <none>.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Deployments (Checking Rollout History: CHANGE-CAUSE from kubernetes.io/change-cause)

claims.text: kubectl apply of a manifest whose template equals the current one changes no Pod and adds no revision, but records it as last applied (kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration); kubectl prints 'configured'.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Declarative Management of Kubernetes Objects Using Configuration Files (last-applied-configuration)

No --to-revision, progressDeadlineSeconds value, automatic rollback, DB rollback, GitOps (depth_notes). R1: stuck undo only scales the bad ReplicaSet down (outline item 4 'scales that old ReplicaSet back up' holds only when it was at 0); ErrImagePull, deadline vs 10 s timeout, CHANGE-CAUSE, last apply explained.
